funders.name: CAPES — Programa de Apoio a Eventos no Exterior (AEX/PAEX)
funders.eligible_who: Doctoral degree holders (professors/researchers) presenting a paper at an internationally recognized event abroad, who have not received AEX support in the previous year
funders.amount_note: A fixed contribution toward travel and accommodation from Brazil to the event's country, amount set by CAPES ordinance and varying by destination region; exact current value not confirmed on the pages fetched
funders.cycle: Recurring CAPES scheme with periodic editais; 2026-27 specific dates not confirmed on the pages fetched — check the current edital before applying
funders.requires: Doctoral diploma, proof of paper acceptance/submission to the event, institutional endorsement
funders.source_note: General description corroborated across multiple .gov.br/university pages; exact 2026-27 edital and amount not located in this run — treat amount as unconfirmed

funders.name: FACEPE — Chamada Confap/ERC IA 2026 (mobilidade internacional de pesquisadores pernambucanos)
funders.eligible_who: Doctorate-holding researchers based in Pernambuco (Beatriz's home state) seeking to join ERC-funded excellence teams in Europe
funders.amount_note: Not confirmed on the pages fetched — this call funds longer research mobility/placements, not short conference trips, so it is a weak fit for a single-event travel grant
funders.cycle: 2026 call; specific deadline not confirmed on the pages fetched (the direct call page returned a 404 on re-fetch)
funders.requires: Integration into a European ERC-funded research team; doctorate
funders.source_note: Included as the researcher's own state science foundation (FACEPE) for completeness, but flagged as a poor match for single-conference travel — FACEPE's own site should be checked directly (facepe.br) for any smaller-scale event/travel-grant edital, which was not found in this run

funders.name: SLAS Latin American Scholars Grant
funders.eligible_who: Scholars based in Latin America (confirmed via address/institutional affiliation) — independent researchers, PhD students and university-affiliated academics — attending and presenting at the SLAS annual conference (UK). SLAS membership is not required to apply.
funders.amount_note: Around ten awards of up to GBP 1,750 to cover registration, travel and accommodation
funders.cycle: Annual, tied to each year's SLAS conference (next confirmed edition: Newcastle University, 2027); application must be supported by an SLAS member
funders.requires: A paper accepted at the SLAS conference; a supporting SLAS-member sponsor making a 'strategic case' for the collaboration
funders.source_note: Real UK-based Latin-American-studies society scheme explicitly targeting Latin-America-based scholars; only relevant if she targets the SLAS conference itself, which is not (yet) one of her chosen 6 opportunities this cycle

funders.name: IAMCR Travel Grants (for the IAMCR annual conference)
funders.eligible_who: Early-career (untenured) IAMCR members of ≥ 1 year, residing in low/middle-income countries (Brazil qualifies), first author of a paper accepted for full presentation at the IAMCR annual conference
funders.amount_note: Up to 18 grants, each max USD 2,000
funders.cycle: Annual, tied to each year's IAMCR conference; the 2026 (Galway) cycle deadline was 20 March 2026 — a 2027 São Paulo-specific cycle had not yet been announced at the time this was checked
funders.requires: Paper acceptance confirmation from section/working-group head, IAMCR membership, full paper by the stated deadline
funders.source_note: Directly relevant since IAMCR 2027 (São Paulo) is one of her opportunities; reused from corpus/funders/india.json's IAMCR entry, which documents the same recurring society-wide scheme

funders.note: Home institution: check the federal university in Pernambuco's own pro-reitoria de pesquisa / assessoria de relações internacionais for an internal postdoc conference-travel fund; specific to the institution and not tracked here.
